name: Vadhnatya Usman — Raspy Low Baritone
description: Adult man aged 42. Low raspy baritone with a dry sardonic edge and slight drunken looseness; mocking party banter. Earthy, rough and masculine with a different nasal grain from the police characters. Native Indian man speaking fluent Hindi with a natural Maharashtrian Hindi accent. Masculine bass/baritone voice, low chest resonance, dark weight, natural gravel and slight throat rasp. Authentic live-action crime-film dialogue, brisk natural conversational delivery, clear Hindi consonants, believable breathing. Clean dry studio recording. No announcer melody, no singing, no exaggerated cartoon monster growl, no digital pitch effect.
